name: AQ3 + The Wallpapers
description: AQ3 and The Wallpapers perform at Era uma vez em Paris, featuring a live concert followed by a DJ set.
longDescription:
AQ3 and The Wallpapers perform at Era uma vez em Paris on 27 November 2026. The venue is located at R. da Galeria de Paris, 106.

The night begins with a live concert at 21:30, followed by a DJ set starting at 23:30. Entry is restricted to attendees aged 18 and over.
